newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint steady vs dlr, BCE mark futures dropping.
newsitem.headline: Forint steady vs dlr, BCE mark futures dropping.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended about flat versus the dollar on Tuesday in what dealers called range trading, but Wednesday might prove stormier, they said.
"Currency futures contracts expire tomorrow (Wednesday). There are a lot of open positions, so things might start happening," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
The last time, the forint fell about 80 pips compared with the National Bank of Hungary's bid, he said.
The forint closed at 153.85/90 to the U.S. unit compared with an opening of 153.87/92, and was some 20 pips weaker than the central bank's bid.
